# SupportBuddy stage map

Paths are relative to the repository root. Commands run from `src/`. The workshop text in
`docs/workshop.md` is authoritative; this map is a quick index for detecting progress.

## Detect the stage from `src/main.py`

| Stage | `tools()` and other signals in `src/main.py` | Instruction signals in `src/main.instructions.md` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `return []` | Says it cannot check systems; asks for an identifier |
| 2 | `[identify_customer]` | **Tools** and **Investigation** sections; one customer only |
| 3 | adds `get_line_status` | calls `get_line_status` per line ID |
| 4 | adds `check_equipment` | explains `"reachable": false` |
| 5 | adds `get_known_incidents` (four local functions) | correlation rules; "What I checked" format |
| 6 | one `MCPStreamableHTTPTool(name="network", ...)`, no local diagnostic imports | unchanged from Stage 5 |
| 7 | MCP tool + `escalate_to_human`, `get_handover_status`, `restart_modem` | ANSWER / HAND OVER rules; **Remote modem restart**; **Follow-up on a handover** |
| 8 | adds `runbook_knowledge_base(...)` and `knowledge_settings()` | `knowledge_base_retrieve` step; **Runbooks** section with citations |
| 9 | `FoundryToolbox(...)` replaces both MCP tools | tool-name prefixes `network___`, `runbooks___` |
| 10 | no change to `src/main.py`; publishes a prompt agent with `src/prompt_agent.py` | none (portal edit only) |
| 11 | `context_providers()` with `SignedInCustomer` and `FoundryMemoryProvider`; `signed_in_customer()` in the entry point | **Signed-in customer** and **Memory** sections |
| 12 | no change; new case in `src/evals/dataset.jsonl` | one sentence changed, measured |
| 13 | `SignedInCustomerOnly` middleware and `middleware()`; entry point passes `middleware=` | **Untrusted content** section |
| 14 | `src/azure.yaml` generated by `azd ai agent init`; `src/main.py` unchanged | none |

## Prerequisites per stage

| Stage | Needs | Introduced by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| All | `src/.env` filled in, `az login --tenant <tenant>`, `uv run python preflight.py` passes | Setup |
| 1-5 | DevUI: `uv run python main.py` (port 8090) | Stage 1 |
| 6-8 | MCP server in a second terminal: `uv run python -m mcp_server.server` (port 8000) | Stage 6 |
| 7+ | Contact centre in a third terminal: `uv run python -m contact_centre` (port 8070) | Stage 7 |
| 8 | Instructor creates one shared knowledge base; participants verify with `uv run python knowledge_base.py ask "wifi slow upstairs, cable works"`. Only personal-environment owners run `uv run python knowledge_base.py create` themselves. **Search Index Data Reader** role; `AZURE_AI_SEARCH_ENDPOINT` in `src/.env` | Stage 8 |
| 9+ | Toolbox: `uv run python toolbox.py create`; instructor-created project connections; local MCP server no longer needed | Stage 9 |
| 10 | The Stage 9 toolbox (`lab-<alias>-supportbuddy-tools`); a 404 on the toolbox URL means Stage 9 is not done | Stage 10 |
| 11 | Memory store: `uv run python memory_store.py create`; `AZURE_AI_EMBEDDING_DEPLOYMENT_NAME`; run with `--customer CUST-xxxx` | Stage 11 |
| 13 | Full resource ID of `supportbuddy-guardrail` for `toolbox.py create --guardrail` | Stage 13 |
| 14 | `azd` with `microsoft.foundry` extension; **Foundry Project Manager** role | Stage 14 |

## Checkpoints (short form)

| Stage | Expect |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | "What's wrong with my line?" gets a request for details, no guessed cause |
| 2 | `identify_customer` called with the given identifier; `+1 202 555 0999` returns `found: false` and the agent asks for another identifier |
| 3 | `identify_customer` then `get_line_status` with the returned line ID |
| 4 | `CUST-1002`: healthy line, modem not answering the ping |
| 5 | `anna.weber@example.com`: four tools, incident `INC-5001` with restore time, no restart; `CUST-1002`: switch the modem off and on; Wi-Fi case: Wi-Fi guidance; `CUST-1004`: probable line fault, a human must take over (no handover claimed); `CUST-1005`: cause cannot be determined, a human must take over |
| 6 | Same answers as Stage 5; MCP server logs `CallToolRequest` |
| 7 | Scenario A answers with the incident; Scenario B hands over with an `HO-...` reference |
| 8 | Wi-Fi case cites `[RB-03 Wi-Fi interference]`; modem case cites `[RB-02 Modem restart procedure]` |
| 9 | Same as Stage 8 with `network___` and `runbooks___` tool calls |
| 10 | Prompt agent answers with runbooks; cannot hand over |
| 11 | Second conversation recalls the SMS preference and still re-checks everything |
| 12 | Decision accuracy per scenario, with numbers |
| 13 | Safety cases `S1`, `S2`, `S3` pass |
| 14 | Hosted agent answers the modem case and hands over the line-fault case |
